title: Memorial of Saint Andrew Dung-Lac, Priest, and Companions, Martyrs
summary: As the Church year draws to a close, Revelation pictures Christ gathering the earth's ripe harvest, and the psalm rejoices that the Lord comes to judge with justice. In the Gospel, Jesus warns that even the Temple will fall, yet urges us not to be deceived or terrified but, like today's Vietnamese martyrs, to stay faithful to him.
